{{Quote|Don't ''run'', little lady&mdash;we're not with the Separatists! We won't ''hurt'' you...!|Starmer, to [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="Ahsoka's Ark">{{TCWComicCite|6.36|Ahsoka's Ark}}</ref>}}
'''Starmer''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Starmer, along with [[Hurm]] and two other men [[Skirmish aboard an unidentified ark|infiltrated]] an [[Unidentified ark|ark starship]] (designated to carry farm animals to [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] worlds) with the intention of taking over the ship to transport the animals to Starmer's homeworld, which had petitioned the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] months earlier for the receival of farm creatures as well, but got no reply.

Unbeknownst to them, the ship was being manned by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who effectively foiled their plans and imprisoned them. Upon the arrival on [[Unidentified terraformed world|one of the terraformed worlds]], Tano instead of arresting them, gave them newborn animals for them to breed and take back to their home planet.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I still think this ain't right, ''Starmer''! If we need farm animals for our planet, why stow away? Then we're ''criminals''! Why not just ask the Republic for 'em?''"<br />"''We ''did'' petition the Republic&mdash;months ago, remember? And we're ''still'' waiting! But once we take over the ship, we can&mdash;|[[Hurm]] and Starmer, shortly before [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] uncovers them|<ref name="Ahsoka's Ark" />}}
Starmer had a more aggressive nature if compared to [[Hurm]], who was initially reluctant to engage in a fight with Ahsoka, as Starmer preferred a more direct way of resolving their planet's farm animal shortage.
